generic_citation: Miguel Ramos, Gonçalo Vieira, David A. Gilichinsky, Miguel Ángel de Pablo Hernández: Permafrost Temperature (PT) at "Mount Reina Sofía. Livingston Island" (Antarctica). Additional Code: AZ 56 SP/PT, GTN-P PID: pt/486.

environmental_setting.vegetation: Vegetation is mostly absent, only some lichens and mosses.
environmental_setting.landform: Hill summit, deglaciated during the Holocene; May have been a nunatak in the early Holocene; Frost shattering very abundant; stone circles and stone-banked solifluction lobes present nearby.
environmental_setting.lithology:
Bedrock: Myers bluff formation (shales, fine sandstones and greywacke) – Carboniferous to Jurassic.

Medium/Low ice content.
environmental_setting.prior_records: No prior long term temperature measurements but some short term measurements and observations on active layer and permafrost.
